subject: DI01009011

body.en:
Understand the idea

A semiconductor has an energy-band structure whose conductivity can be controlled by temperature,doping,light and electric field.

Explanation and application

  • Silicon and germanium are elemental examples;semiconductor does not mean a material with one fixed resistance between a metal and an insulator.
  • Silicon has four valence electrons;in a crystal,each atom shares them with neighbours through covalent bonds.A broken bond can produce an electron-hole pair.
  • An electron in the conduction band can move through the crystal.A hole represents an available valence-band state;successive electron movements make the hole appear to move oppositely.
  • The band gap separates allowed valence and conduction states;it is an energy separation,not a visible crack in the material.Metals have available conducting states,while ordinary insulators have a much less accessible excitation gap.
  • Heating can increase carrier generation,but mobility also changes.A device temperature limit must never be inferred from this qualitative trend.
  • Conductivity depends on carrier concentration and mobility:sigma=q(n mu_n+p mu_p).The relation explains why doping and light can affect conduction.
Does N-type mean a negatively charged bulk sample?

No.Fixed donor ions balance mobile carriers.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Semiconductorની energy-band રચનાને લીધે temperature,doping,light તથા electric fieldથી conductivity નિયંત્રિત થઈ શકે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Silicon તથા germanium elemental examples છે.Semiconductor એટલે metal/insulator વચ્ચે એક fixed resistance ધરાવતો પદાર્થ જ નહિ.
  • Siliconના ચાર valence electrons હોય છે;crystalમાં atom તેમને neighbours સાથે covalent bondsથી share કરે છે.Bond તૂટે ત્યારે electron-hole pair બની શકે છે.
  • Conduction bandનો electron crystalમાં ફરી શકે છે.Hole એ valence bandમાં ખાલી state છે;ક્રમશઃ electron movementsથી hole સામેની દિશામાં ચાલતો દેખાય છે.
  • Band gap allowed valence તથા conduction states વચ્ચેનું energy separation છે;materialની visible તિરાડ નહિ.Metalsમાં conducting states ઉપલબ્ધ હોય છે;ordinary insulatorsમાં excitation gap પાર કરવો ઘણો મુશ્કેલ હોય છે.
  • Heatingથી carrier generation વધી શકે છે,પણ mobility પણ બદલાય છે.આ trendથી deviceનું safe temperature limit નક્કી ન કરવું.
  • Conductivity carrier concentration તથા mobility પર આધારિત છે:sigma=q(n mu_n+p mu_p).આથી doping/light conduction બદલી શકે છે.
N-type એટલે Overall Negative Sample?

ના.Fixed donor ions mobile carriersને balance કરે છે.

h.en: Intrinsic,N-type and P-type:keep charge and carriers separate

body.en:
Understand the idea

Doping is controlled addition of suitable impurities to alter carrier populations,not simply charging the crystal.

Explanation and application

  • Intrinsic material has equal electron and hole concentrations at equilibrium:n=p=ni.Thermal generation and recombination balance.
  • Pentavalent donors such as phosphorus or arsenic in silicon supply an easily liberated electron.N-type has electrons as majority carriers and holes as minority carriers.
  • Trivalent acceptors such as boron or gallium create a missing bonding electron.P-type has holes as majority carriers and electrons as minority carriers.
  • N-type is not negatively charged bulk material;positive donor ions balance mobile electrons.P-type is likewise neutral with fixed acceptor ions.
  • Both carrier types can contribute to current.In equilibrium np=ni² under the usual nondegenerate semiconductor model;doping changes their relative concentrations.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Doping એટલે યોગ્ય impurityનું controlled addition કરીને carrier population બદલવું;crystalને charge કરવું જ નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Intrinsic materialમાં equilibriumએ n=p=ni હોય છે.Thermal generation/recombination balance થાય છે.
  • Siliconમાં phosphorus/arsenic જેવા pentavalent donor સહેલાઈથી મુક્ત થતો electron આપે છે.N-typeમાં electrons majority અને holes minority carriers છે.
  • Boron/gallium જેવા trivalent acceptorથી bondમાં electronની ખોટ થાય છે.P-typeમાં holes majority અને electrons minority carriers છે.
  • N-type bulk negative charge ધરાવતું નથી;positive donor ions mobile electronsને balance કરે છે.P-type પણ fixed acceptor ions સાથે neutral છે.
  • બંને carrier types current આપી શકે છે.Usual nondegenerate equilibrium modelમાં np=ni² થાય છે;doping relative concentrations બદલે છે.

h.en: PN diode:from junction to one-way conduction

body.en:
Definition

A PN junction diode is a two-terminal device whose current depends strongly on junction polarity.

Classification / representative type

  • Rectifier,signal and Zener diodes are selected for different duties;this card explains the ordinary PN junction.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. P region contains acceptor doping and majority holes.
  2. N region contains donor doping and majority electrons.
  3. The joined regions form a depletion layer with few mobile carriers.
  4. Fixed ions establish an internal field and potential barrier.
  5. Anode contacts the P side;cathode contacts the N side in the basic junction model.
  6. Package,contacts and junction area determine practical current,thermal and voltage capabilities.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. At equilibrium,diffusion is balanced by drift;net terminal current is zero.
  2. Forward bias makes anode positive relative to cathode and reduces the junction barrier.
  3. Majority carriers cross and recombine;external circuitry supplies replacements.
  4. Current rises rapidly with forward voltage,so external current limiting is essential.
  5. Reverse bias widens depletion;small leakage flows before breakdown.
  6. Exceeding reverse or thermal ratings can damage the diode;do not use unintended breakdown as regulation.

Applications

Rectification,polarity protection and signal steering,subject to ratings.

Limitations and safety

Forward drop depends on current,temperature and device type.Check VRRM,IF,IFSM,power and recovery time.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

PN junction diode two-terminal device છે;તેનો current junction polarity પર ખૂબ આધારિત છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Rectifier,signal તથા Zener diodes જુદા duties માટે પસંદ થાય છે.આ card સામાન્ય PN junction સમજાવે છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. P regionમાં acceptor doping તથા majority holes હોય છે.
  2. N regionમાં donor doping તથા majority electrons હોય છે.
  3. Joined regions વચ્ચે ઓછા mobile carriersવાળું depletion layer બને છે.
  4. Fixed ions internal field તથા potential barrier બનાવે છે.
  5. Basic junction modelમાં anode P side અને cathode N side સાથે જોડાય છે.
  6. Package,contacts તથા junction area practical current,thermal/voltage capability નક્કી કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Equilibriumમાં diffusion/drift balance થતાં net terminal current zero છે.
  2. Forward biasમાં anode cathode કરતાં positive હોવાથી barrier ઘટે છે.
  3. Majority carriers cross/recombine થાય છે;external circuit replacements આપે છે.
  4. Forward voltageથી current ઝડપથી વધે છે;external current limiting જરૂરી છે.
  5. Reverse bias depletion પહોળું કરે છે;breakdown પહેલાં નાનો leakage current રહે છે.
  6. Reverse/thermal rating વટાવવાથી diode બગડે છે;unintended breakdownને regulation ન માનો.

ઉપયોગ

Ratings મુજબ rectification,polarity protection અને signal steering.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Forward drop current,temperature તથા type મુજબ બદલાય છે.VRRM,IF,IFSM,power/recovery time તપાસો.

h.en: Reading the diode curve and polarity

body.en:
Understand the idea

For the plotted convention VD=VA−VK and positive ID enters the anode.

Explanation and application

  • A silicon drop near0.7V is a stated engineering approximation,not an exact threshold for every diode.
  • Forward resistance V/I at one point differs from incremental resistance Delta V/Delta I around that point.
  • Reverse leakage is temperature-dependent;an ohmmeter or diode-test reading is not proof of full reverse-voltage withstand.
  • Cathode bar in the symbol and package band are useful clues,but verify the exact part marking and data sheet before wiring.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Plotted conventionમાં VD=VA−VK અને positive ID anodeમાં પ્રવેશે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Silicon માટે આશરે0.7V stated approximation છે;દરેક diodeનું exact threshold નહિ.
  • એક pointનું V/I forward resistance અને તેની આસપાસનું Delta V/Delta I incremental resistance જુદાં છે.
  • Reverse leakage temperature-dependent છે.Ohm/diode-test readingથી full reverse-voltage withstand સાબિત થતું નથી.
  • Symbol cathode bar તથા package band clues છે,પણ wiring પહેલાં exact marking/data sheet verify કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A Zener diode is designed for specified reverse-breakdown operation with controlled current.

Classification / representative type

  • Low-voltage tunnelling and higher-voltage avalanche mechanisms can both occur in devices sold as Zener diodes.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A specially doped PN junction sets the intended breakdown range.
  2. The cathode is connected to the positive output for reverse shunt regulation.
  3. The anode returns to the circuit common.
  4. Series resistor Rs limits supply current and absorbs excess voltage.
  5. Load RL shares the output terminals with the Zener.
  6. Package power and thermal derating restrict allowable Zener current.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Below breakdown,the reverse current may be too small for regulation.
  2. Near the specified current,the output stays close to VZ rather than perfectly constant.
  3. Supply current is (Vin−VZ)/Rs.
  4. Load takes IL;the remaining current is IZ=IS−IL.
  5. Increasing load current reduces IZ;falling below the required range loses regulation.
  6. At high input/light load,check PZ=VZ IZ and resistor power to avoid overheating.

Applications

Reference and simple low-power shunt regulation,not arbitrary high-power supply control.

Limitations and safety

Use data-sheet current range,tolerance,dynamic resistance and temperature coefficient.Do not connect directly across a supply.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Zener diode specified reverse-breakdownમાં controlled current સાથે કામ કરવા રચાયેલો છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Zener નામે મળતા devicesમાં low-voltage tunnelling તથા higher-voltage avalanche mechanisms હોઈ શકે છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Specially doped PN junction intended breakdown range નક્કી કરે છે.
  2. Reverse shunt regulationમાં cathode positive output સાથે જોડાય છે.
  3. Anode circuit common તરફ return થાય છે.
  4. Series Rs supply current limit કરીને વધારાનું voltage drop લે છે.
  5. Load RL Zenerના output terminals share કરે છે.
  6. Package power તથા thermal derating allowable Zener current મર્યાદિત કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Breakdownથી નીચે reverse current regulation માટે ઓછો હોઈ શકે છે.
  2. Specified current નજીક output VZ પાસે રહે છે;perfect constant નહિ.
  3. Supply current (Vin−VZ)/Rs છે.
  4. Load IL લે છે;બાકી current IZ=IS−IL છે.
  5. Load current વધતાં IZ ઘટે છે;required rangeથી નીચે regulation ખોવાય છે.
  6. High input/light loadમાં overheating ટાળવા PZ=VZ IZ તથા resistor power તપાસો.

ઉપયોગ

Reference તથા simple low-power shunt regulation;arbitrary high-power supply control નહિ.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Data-sheet current range,tolerance,dynamic resistance તથા temperature coefficient લો.Supply ઉપર direct ન જોડો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

The Zener operating branch is reverse biased;with anode-current reference,both VD and ID are negative there.

Explanation and application

  • Below knee current the output can depart substantially from the nominal VZ.
  • Dynamic resistance means a current change also changes voltage;regulation is approximate.
  • The upper useful current is limited by device power,temperature and data-sheet conditions,not by a perfect mathematical vertical line.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Zener operating branch reverse biased છે;anode-current referenceમાં ત્યાં VD તથા ID બંને negative છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Knee currentથી નીચે output nominal VZથી નોંધપાત્ર જુદું પડી શકે છે.
  • Dynamic resistanceને કારણે current changeથી voltage પણ બદલાય છે;regulation approximate છે.
  • Upper useful current device power,temperature તથા data-sheet conditionsથી મર્યાદિત છે;perfect mathematical vertical lineથી નહિ.

h.en: Zener regulator:check the whole operating range

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Ideal VZ=5.1V,Rs=330ohm,Vin=9–12V,IL=5–10mA.Assume the data sheet permits IZ=1–30mA for this exercise.

Step-by-step solution

  1. IS,min=(9−5.1)/330=11.818mA;IZ,min=11.818−10=1.818mA
  2. IS,max=(12−5.1)/330=20.909mA;IZ,max=20.909−5=15.909mA
  3. PZ,max=5.1×0.015909=0.08114W;PR,max=(12−5.1)²/330=0.14427W

Interpretation and check

The assumed current range is satisfied.Select rated parts with thermal margin;real VZ tolerance/loading can change these numbers.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Ideal VZ=5.1V,Rs=330ohm,Vin=9–12V,IL=5–10mA.આ exerciseમાં data sheet IZ=1–30mA મંજૂર કરે છે એવી ધારણા.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. IS,min=(9−5.1)/330=11.818mA;IZ,min=11.818−10=1.818mA
  2. IS,max=(12−5.1)/330=20.909mA;IZ,max=20.909−5=15.909mA
  3. PZ,max=5.1×0.015909=0.08114W;PR,max=(12−5.1)²/330=0.14427W

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Assumed current range સંતોષાય છે.Thermal marginવાળા parts લો;real VZ tolerance/loadingથી આ આંકડા બદલાય છે.

body.en:
Definition

A rectifier makes load current unidirectional from an AC input;its unfiltered output still pulsates.

Classification / representative type

  • Half-wave uses one diode and one pulse per input cycle.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Use an approved isolated low-voltage AC source.
  2. Identify the source terminals and their peak/RMS voltage definitions.
  3. Orient the diode network to obtain the marked output polarity.
  4. Mark positive output and its return before attaching instruments.
  5. A rated RL provides the load current path and dissipates output power.
  6. No smoothing capacitor is present in this unfiltered comparison.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. On the favourable input half-cycle,forward-biased diode paths conduct.
  2. Trace source,conducting diode,load and source return as one closed loop.
  3. The negative half-cycle reverse-biases the diode and gives approximately zero load current.
  4. Load polarity does not reverse in the intended conducting paths.
  5. Output pulses repeat at input frequency f.
  6. Finite diode drops,source resistance and load alter actual peak and average output.

Applications

AC-to-pulsating-DC front ends and supervised rectifier trainers.

Limitations and safety

Ideal formulas assume a sine source,resistive load and no filter.PIV changes when capacitor charging or other conditions are introduced.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rectifier AC inputમાંથી load current unidirectional કરે છે;unfiltered output હજી pulsating રહે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Half-waveમાં એક diode તથા input cycle દીઠ એક pulse મળે છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Approved isolated low-voltage AC source લો.
  2. Source terminals તથા peak/RMS voltageની વ્યાખ્યા ઓળખો.
  3. Marked output polarity માટે diode network યોગ્ય orient કરો.
  4. Instruments પહેલાં positive output તથા return mark કરો.
  5. Rated RL load-current path આપે છે તથા output power dissipate કરે છે.
  6. આ unfiltered comparisonમાં smoothing capacitor નથી.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Favourable input half-cycleમાં forward-biased diode paths conduct કરે છે.
  2. Source,conducting diode,load તથા returnનો closed loop trace કરો.
  3. Negative half-cycle diodeને reverse-bias કરતાં load current આશરે zero થાય છે.
  4. Intended conducting pathsમાં load polarity reverse થતી નથી.
  5. Output pulses input frequency fએ મળે છે.
  6. Finite diode drops,source R તથા load actual peak/average output બદલે છે.

ઉપયોગ

ACથી pulsating-DC front ends તથા supervised rectifier trainers.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Ideal formulas sine source,resistive load તથા no filter માટે છે.Capacitor charging/બીજી conditionsમાં PIV બદલાય છે.

body.en:
Definition

A rectifier makes load current unidirectional from an AC input;its unfiltered output still pulsates.

Classification / representative type

  • Full-wave uses both half-cycles;centre-tapped and bridge circuits differ in transformer and diode needs.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Use an approved isolated low-voltage AC source.
  2. A centre-tapped secondary provides opposite half-winding voltages relative to CT.
  3. Two diode anodes connect to opposite winding ends.
  4. Both cathodes meet the positive load terminal.
  5. A rated RL provides the load current path and dissipates output power.
  6. No smoothing capacitor is present in this unfiltered comparison.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. On the favourable input half-cycle,forward-biased diode paths conduct.
  2. Trace source,conducting diode,load and source return as one closed loop.
  3. The other diode takes over on the opposite half-cycle.
  4. Load polarity does not reverse in the intended conducting paths.
  5. Output ripple repeats at2f for a sinusoidal input.
  6. Finite diode drops,source resistance and load alter actual peak and average output.

Applications

AC-to-pulsating-DC front ends and supervised rectifier trainers.

Limitations and safety

Ideal formulas assume a sine source,resistive load and no filter.PIV changes when capacitor charging or other conditions are introduced.

  3. બે diode anodes opposite winding ends સાથે જોડાય છે.
  4. બંને cathodes positive load terminal પર મળે છે.
  5. Rated RL load-current path આપે છે તથા output power dissipate કરે છે.
  6. આ unfiltered comparisonમાં smoothing capacitor નથી.

  1. Favourable input half-cycleમાં forward-biased diode paths conduct કરે છે.
  2. Source,conducting diode,load તથા returnનો closed loop trace કરો.
  3. Opposite half-cycleમાં બીજો diode conduct કરે છે.
  4. Intended conducting pathsમાં load polarity reverse થતી નથી.
  5. Sinusoidal input માટે output ripple2fએ repeat થાય છે.
  6. Finite diode drops,source R તથા load actual peak/average output બદલે છે.

વ્યાખ્યા

Rectifier AC inputમાંથી load current unidirectional કરે છે;unfiltered output હજી pulsating રહે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Full-wave બંને half-cycles વાપરે છે;centre-tapped/bridgeની transformer તથા diode જરૂરિયાત જુદી છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Approved isolated low-voltage AC source લો.
  2. Source terminals તથા peak/RMS voltageની વ્યાખ્યા ઓળખો.
  3. Marked output polarity માટે diode network યોગ્ય orient કરો.
  4. Instruments પહેલાં positive output તથા return mark કરો.
  5. Rated RL load-current path આપે છે તથા output power dissipate કરે છે.
  6. આ unfiltered comparisonમાં smoothing capacitor નથી.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Favourable input half-cycleમાં forward-biased diode paths conduct કરે છે.
  2. Left AC terminal positive હોય ત્યારે D1 તથા D4 conduct કરે છે.
  3. Opposite half-cycleમાં D2 તથા D3 conduct કરે છે.
  4. Intended conducting pathsમાં load polarity reverse થતી નથી.
  5. Sinusoidal input માટે output ripple2fએ repeat થાય છે.
  6. Finite diode drops,source R તથા load actual peak/average output બદલે છે.

ઉપયોગ

ACથી pulsating-DC front ends તથા supervised rectifier trainers.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Ideal formulas sine source,resistive load તથા no filter માટે છે.Capacitor charging/બીજી conditionsમાં PIV બદલાય છે.

h.en: Rectifier comparison:state the model before the formula

body.en:
Understand the idea

Let Vm be the peak available to the conducting path and RL a resistive load;diodes are ideal and there is no filter.

Explanation and application

  • Half-wave:Vdc=Vm/pi,Vrms=Vm/2,ideal ripple factor about1.21,maximum ideal rectification efficiency about40.53%.
  • Full-wave:Vdc=2Vm/pi,Vrms=Vm/sqrt(2),ripple factor about0.48343,maximum ideal efficiency about81.06%.
  • Ideal unfiltered PIV:half-wave Vm,centre-tapped2Vm per diode,bridge Vm per diode.For CT,Vm is one half-secondary peak.
  • Bridge uses four diodes with two conducting drops;CT uses two diodes but needs a centre-tapped winding and one conducting drop.
  • Many rounded classroom tables quote40.6%,81.2%and0.482;these are approximate constants,not different waveform laws.
  • Ripple factor r=Vac,rms/Vdc=sqrt((Vrms/Vdc)²−1);Vrms includes both AC and DC components.
  • Rectification efficiency compares DC load power with AC input power in the stated model;it is not transformer efficiency or voltage regulation.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Vm conducting pathને મળતું peak તથા RL resistive load છે;diodes ideal અને filter નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Half-wave:Vdc=Vm/pi,Vrms=Vm/2,ideal ripple factor આશરે1.21,maximum ideal rectification efficiency આશરે40.53%.
  • Full-wave:Vdc=2Vm/pi,Vrms=Vm/sqrt(2),ripple factor આશરે0.48343,maximum ideal efficiency આશરે81.06%.
  • Ideal unfiltered PIV:half-wave Vm,centre-tappedમાં diode દીઠ2Vm,bridgeમાં diode દીઠ Vm.CTમાં Vm એક half-secondaryનું peak છે.
  • Bridgeમાં ચાર diodes તથા બે conducting drops છે;CTમાં બે diodes,centre-tapped winding અને એક conducting drop છે.
  • ઘણી rounded classroom tables40.6%,81.2%તથા0.482 આપે છે;આ approximate constants છે,અલગ waveform laws નહિ.
  • Ripple factor r=Vac,rms/Vdc=sqrt((Vrms/Vdc)²−1);Vrmsમાં AC તથા DC બંને છે.
  • Rectification efficiency stated modelમાં DC load power/AC input powerનો ratio છે;transformer efficiency/voltage regulation નહિ.

h.en: Rectifier example:avoid the centre-tap factor mistake

body.en:
Given and assumptions

An isolated12Vrms full secondary feeds an ideal bridge with RL=1kohm,no filter.Input frequency50Hz.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Vm=12sqrt(2)=16.971V;Vdc=2Vm/pi=10.804V
  2. Idc=10.804mA;Vrms=12V;Pdc=Vdc²/1000=0.11672W
  3. Ptotal=Vrms²/1000=0.144W;eta=Pdc/Ptotal=81.06%;fripple=100Hz

Interpretation and check

The commonly quoted textbook value81.2%is approximate;the ideal exact ratio is8/pi².With two0.7V drops,peak output is approximately15.571V,but do not subtract a peak drop from every ideal average formula blindly.

Isolated12Vrms full secondary ideal bridgeને RL=1kohm સાથે આપે છે;filter નથી.Input frequency50Hz.

h.en: What a filter does—and does not do
h.gu: Filter શું કરે અને શું નથી કરતો?

body.en:
Understand the idea

A smoothing filter attenuates ripple after rectification;it does not by itself hold output constant against every line/load change.

Explanation and application

  • C has low impedance for sufficiently high ripple frequency and stores energy in its electric field.L opposes changes of current and stores magnetic energy.
  • Filter action depends on frequency,load and component parasitics:XC=1/(2pi f C),XL=2pi f L.
  • Always discharge capacitors by a verified controlled method and protect against inductive transients;disconnecting supply does not prove zero stored energy.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Smoothing filter rectification પછી ripple ઘટાડે છે;દરેક line/load change સામે output constant રાખતો નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • C sufficiently high ripple frequency માટે low impedance તથા electric-field energy storage આપે છે.L current changesને oppose કરીને magnetic energy store કરે છે.
  • Filter action frequency,load તથા parasitics પર આધારિત છે:XC=1/(2pi f C),XL=2pi f L.
  • Capacitorsને verified controlled methodથી discharge કરો અને inductive transients સામે protection રાખો.Supply disconnect એટલે stored energy zero નહિ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Identify component placement first,then trace DC and ripple behaviour separately.

Explanation and application

  • A capacitor is connected across RL with correct polarity and voltage rating.
  • Near each rectified crest,the diode supplies load and replenishes capacitor charge.
  • Between crests,the diode may stop conducting and C supplies the load,so voltage droops.
  • Larger C or smaller load current reduces ripple,but larger charging pulses can stress diodes and source.
  • For small ripple,Delta Vpp≈IL/(fripple C);this approximation assumes nearly constant load and brief recharge intervals.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પહેલાં component placement ઓળખો;પછી DC તથા ripple behaviour અલગ trace કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Capacitor correct polarity/voltage rating સાથે RLની parallel જોડાય છે.
  • Rectified crest નજીક diode loadને current તથા capacitorને charge આપે છે.
  • Crests વચ્ચે diode બંધ થઈ શકે છે;C loadને current આપતાં voltage droop થાય છે.
  • મોટો C/નાનો load current ripple ઘટાડે છે,પણ મોટા charging pulses diode/sourceને stress આપે છે.
  • Small ripple માટે Delta Vpp≈IL/(fripple C);nearly constant load તથા brief rechargeની ધારણા છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Identify component placement first,then trace DC and ripple behaviour separately.

Explanation and application

  • A rated choke is inserted in series with the load,not as a short across output.
  • Changing current creates a counter voltage according to vL=L di/dt.
  • The DC resistance produces a real voltage drop and copper loss.
  • Core saturation reduces useful inductance;verify DC-current and insulation ratings.
  • Current smoothing depends on load and ripple frequency;an inductor alone does not guarantee ripple-free voltage.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પહેલાં component placement ઓળખો;પછી DC તથા ripple behaviour અલગ trace કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Rated choke loadની seriesમાં આવે છે;output ઉપર shortરૂપે નહિ.
  • Changing currentથી vL=L di/dt મુજબ counter voltage થાય છે.
  • DC resistanceથી real voltage drop તથા copper loss થાય છે.
  • Core saturation useful inductance ઘટાડે છે;DC-current/insulation ratings તપાસો.
  • Current smoothing load/ripple frequency પર આધારિત છે;L એકલો ripple-free voltageની ખાતરી નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Identify component placement first,then trace DC and ripple behaviour separately.

Explanation and application

  • The shown circuit uses series L followed by shunt C across the load.
  • L limits ripple-current changes while C provides a lower-impedance ripple path.
  • The interaction can resonate;component values and damping/load matter.
  • Choke-input operation needs adequate current/inductance;do not apply capacitor-input peak-output assumptions automatically.
  • The load sees a smoother output but source/loading changes can still alter its DC level.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પહેલાં component placement ઓળખો;પછી DC તથા ripple behaviour અલગ trace કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • દર્શાવેલા circuitમાં series L પછી load ઉપર shunt C છે.
  • L ripple-current changes મર્યાદિત કરે છે;C ripple માટે lower-impedance path આપે છે.
  • Interactionથી resonance થઈ શકે છે;values તથા damping/load મહત્વનાં છે.
  • Choke-input માટે પૂરતો current/L જોઈએ;capacitor-input peak-output assumptions આપોઆપ ન વાપરો.
  • Loadને smoother output મળે છે,પણ source/loadingથી DC level હજી બદલાય છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Identify component placement first,then trace DC and ripple behaviour separately.

Explanation and application

  • An input shunt C,series L and output shunt C resemble the pi topology.
  • The first capacitor stores crest energy and reduces initial voltage ripple.
  • The choke impedes ripple current between capacitor sections.
  • The final capacitor shunts residual ripple at the load.
  • Inrush,charging pulse current,capacitor ripple rating and choke saturation require checks;more parts do not mean automatic regulation.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

પહેલાં component placement ઓળખો;પછી DC તથા ripple behaviour અલગ trace કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Input shunt C,series L તથા output shunt Cથી pi topology બને છે.
  • પહેલો C crest energy store કરીને initial voltage ripple ઘટાડે છે.
  • Choke capacitor sections વચ્ચે ripple currentને impede કરે છે.
  • છેલ્લો C load ઉપર residual ripple shunt કરે છે.
  • Inrush,charging pulses,C ripple rating તથા choke saturation તપાસવા પડે;વધુ parts એટલે automatic regulation નહિ.

h.en: Why C-filter output has a higher DC level
h.gu: C-filter Outputનું DC Level કેમ ઊંચું હોય?

body.en:
Understand the idea

A capacitor does not merely erase the AC part of an unfiltered waveform;it stores charge and changes diode conduction intervals.

Explanation and application

  • Between crests,the capacitor supplies the load and its voltage falls gradually;recharge occurs near a later crest.
  • The output can remain near the rectified peak,so the unfiltered full-wave mean2Vm/pi is no longer the correct filtered-output formula.
  • Changing load or RC changes droop and recharge stress;the drawn curve is an illustrative model,not a claimed laboratory trace.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Capacitor ફક્ત unfiltered waveformનો AC ભાગ erase નથી કરતો;તે charge store કરીને diode conduction intervals બદલે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Crests વચ્ચે capacitor loadને current આપતાં voltage ધીમે ઘટે છે;પછીના crest નજીક recharge થાય છે.
  • Output rectified peak નજીક રહી શકે છે;એટલે unfiltered full-wave mean2Vm/pi filtered-output માટે યોગ્ય formula નથી.
  • Load/RC બદલતાં droop તથા recharge stress બદલાય છે;દર્શાવેલો curve illustrative model છે,laboratory traceનો દાવો નહિ.

Given and assumptions

Full-wave50Hz rectifier,IL=20mA,C=1000microF;assume small ripple and roughly constant load.

Step-by-step solution

  1. fripple=2×50=100Hz;Delta Vpp≈0.020/(100×0.001)=0.20V

Full-wave50Hz rectifier,IL=20mA,C=1000microF;small ripple તથા roughly constant loadની ધારણા.

આ estimate છે,CRO reading નહિ.Actual charging/source R waveform/DC બદલી શકે છે.DCની સામે ripple જોઈને small-ripple assumption તપાસો.

Aim

Trace forward/reverse trends within safe ratings.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact fused leads,correct sockets and suitable ranges;verify the device data sheet and the actual trainer/manual.
  • Adjustable limited DC source,rated diode,series limiter and suitable current/voltage meters.

Circuit connections

Supply → limiter → current meter → diode → return;voltmeter across diode.Reverse the diode only with supply OFF.

Supervised procedure

  1. Identify anode,cathode and maximum allowed test current/reverse voltage.
  2. Set source to minimum and preselect limiter/ranges so a forward junction cannot be overdriven.
  3. Connect forward bias,check polarities and raise voltage in small supervised steps.
  4. Record actual VD and ID,using smaller steps in the steep-current region.
  5. Power OFF,verify safe reverse setup and measure only within specified reverse limits;do not force breakdown.
  6. Plot signed I-V axes and distinguish leakage,forward rise and local slope.

Calculations and interpretation

Static resistance=VD/ID at a stated point;incremental resistance=Delta VD/Delta ID locally.Explain limitations near zero current.

Fault finding

  • Unexpected zero current:check open lead,reversed diode or range;excess current:stop and inspect limiter/polarity.

Safety

Use an approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage trainer under supervision.Power OFF before rewiring;verify pinout and ratings.Never defeat protective earth.

body.en:
Aim

Observe actual input/output waveforms and compare rectification paths.

Instruments and selection

  • DMM with intact fused leads,correct sockets and suitable ranges;verify the device data sheet and the actual trainer/manual.
  • Approved isolated low-voltage AC rectifier trainer,rated RL,CRO/DSO and approved probes.

Circuit connections

Use the corresponding Notes circuit without a filter.Identify AC terminals,output polarity and the trainer-approved probe return;CT is not the same as a bridge AC terminal.

Supervised procedure

  1. With power OFF,verify diode directions,load rating and secondary voltage definition.
  2. Complete the scope-reference check before attaching any earth clip.
  3. Select probe factor,DC coupling,safe voltage scale and suitable timebase.
  4. Power ON at the approved input and observe input and load waveforms only with permitted connections.
  5. Record actual peak,time period,pulse frequency and DC mean by an appropriate instrument;label scales.
  6. Trace the conducting path for each half-cycle and compare actual drops with the ideal model.
  7. Power OFF and restore the trainer;do not reconfigure a powered bridge.

Calculations and interpretation

f=1/T.Compare one output pulse per input cycle for half-wave and two for full-wave;use the correct Vm definition and distinguish RMS from mean.

Fault finding

  • Missing alternate full-wave pulses can indicate an open diode/path;inverted output suggests wrong polarity.Stop for unexpected heating or clip-induced faults.

Safety

Use an approved isolated,current-limited low-voltage trainer under supervision.Power OFF before rewiring;verify pinout and ratings.Never defeat protective earth. Check CRO/DSO earth-referenced clips,probe attenuation and permitted common point before power ON.A bridge output may require an approved differential/isolated measurement method;never float an ordinary scope by removing earth.

body.en:
Understand the idea

An ordinary bench CRO ground clip is normally connected to protective earth,so attaching it is an electrical connection.
